message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The background is a pale-yellow tan color. Two men are depicted in a stylized, illustrative manner. 

The man in the foreground is seated and faces right. He has short dark hair and tanned skin, wearing a white, long-sleeved collared shirt. He holds a red-and-yellow can in his left hand and a paintbrush with an orange handle in his right hand. He is painting a red horizontal shape onto the background wall, which resembles a map outline. 

Behind him, a larger man stands facing right. He wears a black songkok hat and a white, short-sleeved collared shirt. He is using a blue crayon to scribble a dense mess of blue lines over a pale-gray map-like shape.

Text on the cover includes "MENTERI ENGGAR DAN AMPLOP SERANGAN FAJAR" and "LANGKAH KUDA EKSPANSI MANDIRI" at the top. The main headline reads "RAHASIA KEMENANGAN" in large black letters. Below it, smaller text says: "UNGGUL VERSI HITUNG CEPAT, PEROLEHAN SUARA JOKOWI TAK BERANJAK DIBANDING PEMILU 2014. KARENA HOAKS ATAU SEBAB LAIN?" In the bottom right, date and pricing information is listed next to a barcode.
